comment: Proposed default mapping (QWB-50; cube renamed QWB-54 ticket 12): the fields the crm/organizations cube actually has. The owner signs off after reading the staging profile; cf_* columns and the fields listed under dropped stay out unless the profile says otherwise. cube/table name the database home of the unique externalId index (QWB-54, ticket 13).
dropped: parentid (account-to-account hierarchy is out of scope)
annualrevenue (bare integer, no currency - stays out until carried in minor units)
ship_* address block (the cube keeps only billing)
pobox columns (not in the cube schema)
all cf_* columns (decided from the staging profile, owner signs off)
